name: Fair Basilica
description: The Fair Basilica is Elesh Norn's stronghold, a layer inside the nested plane of New Phyrexia.

description_citations.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
description_citations.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

summary.text: The Fair Basilica is Elesh Norn's stronghold, a layer inside the nested plane of New Phyrexia.

citations.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citations.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

bio.text: Elesh Norn leads the Fair Basilica, which is located within Mirrodin as a layer inside the nested plane.

citations.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citations.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

bio.text: In its courtyard Norn addressed the Phyrexian faithful while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.

citations.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

bio.text: She later found an organic weed sprouting through the flagstones, which turned out to be a human forearm.

citations.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

status.text: The material's last event shows Norn finding a human forearm sprouting through the courtyard flagstones, and does not say what became of the Basilica.

citations.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Nahiri cleaves Sheoldred's Coliseum from the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: Since Nahiri cleaved it from the Dross Pits , Sheoldred's Coliseum now rests in this layer.

citation.work: New Phyrexia (plane)
citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Spheres of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn addresses the Phyrexian faithful in the Fair Basilica's courtyard while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.
timeline.quote: "Soon, this wretched human will be released from the burden of fear.

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn pours her glistening oil over the Mirran, who convulses and sprouts fibrous roots through her body.
timeline.quote: a pulpy cord of organic material, a fibrous wooden root, sinuous and alien, burst from the human's belly.

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn slays the Mirran with a blade of her porcelain armor and tells the crowd she was too corrupt to save, hiding her own unease.
timeline.quote: "She was a vessel so corrupt, not even our glistening oil could save her.

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn returns to the courtyard and finds an organic weed sprouting through the flagstones, which turns out to be a human forearm.
timeline.quote: Instead, a human forearm dangled, disproportionately large, half-rotten

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: More body-part weeds grow all over the courtyard, and Norn begins to doubt that she herself might be the flaw.
timeline.quote: Was she somehow intrinsically corrupt?

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn realizes the world is a dream-like illusion and names the planeswalker Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Scowling, she whispered, "Ashiok."

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears, admits to creating the nightmare as art and testing whether a Phyrexian mind can be afraid.
timeline.quote: I was not certain Phyrexians would be suitable for my art.

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: "Her name is Elspeth Tirel."

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn rejects Ashiok, summoning dream Phyrexians from her own will and declaring that they are one.
timeline.quote: "We are one," Norn said.

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: The nightmare garden merges into creatures that attack, and Phyrexians and Norn cut them down.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians surged forward, slicing through the dream manifestations

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok shapes a nightmare Elspeth in the mirror of Norn's form, which frightens Norn before she slays it.
timeline.quote: she flung it into the nightmare version of Elspeth Tirel

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok flees, the nightmare dissolves and Norn is left shaken by the pity in the false Elspeth's eyes.
timeline.quote: She looked at Norn with such human pity

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Norn resolves to find Elspeth Tirel and rid the Multiverse of her.
timeline.quote: she would need to find the human, Elspeth Tirel, and rid the Multiverse of her.

citation.work: A GARDEN OF FLESH
citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn lies bound on a slab as Suture Bishops dissect him, offering no resistance, while Tezzeret watches.
timeline.quote: But Karn gave no resistance to the team of aspirants as they bound him into place

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani, compleated, quotes Elesh Norn's scripture over Karn as the priests dismantle him.
timeline.quote: Only in her grace are we saved,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: An angel blocks Tezzeret from leaving and orders him to carry the pieces of Karn to Elesh Norn for his reward.
timeline.quote: you will bring the pieces of Father to our Mother.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani gives Tezzeret his cloak, once worn by Elspeth, and Tezzeret suspects the true Ajani remains suppressed within.
timeline.quote: it was the same cloak once worn by Elspeth Tirel.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret feigns obedience and sets out through the Fair Basilica toward the core pushing Karn's pieces.
timeline.quote: As our Mother wishes,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to seek out and kill the traitor Geth, a Steel Thane of the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: I want you to seek him out, Ixhel. I want you to end him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa tells Ixhel she is her most perfect creation, and Ixhel feels a flare of something beyond loyalty.
timeline.quote: You are my most perfect creation.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa reacts with disdain, and Ixhel admits she wanted to make something, and names her creation Vishgraz.
timeline.quote: His name is Vishgraz.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to get rid of it and leaves.
timeline.quote: Get rid of it,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel realizes the new being carries Geth's head and her own wings, and tells him she wanted to save him.
timeline.quote: I wanted to save you,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa appears fighting Phyrexian invaders above the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: the gleaming, wide-winged form of Atraxa

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace, burned by Vraska's venom, asks for the sylex back, and Melira cannot heal him here.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to survive this as it stands, I may as well be the one to trigger the blast.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
timeline.quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The survivors hurry across the Fair Basilica's bridges, mourning Nahiri's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: We have to keep moving to honor the ending she chose.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira reveals Nahiri had asked for help at the Furnace, and that curing phyresis would have sidelined her for days.
timeline.quote: Repairing her body from the damage already done would have left her incapacitated for days.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace says through telepathy that he will not risk the mission to save his own life.
timeline.quote: I'm not risking us all to save my own life, not when we've already lost Vraska.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito says he hopes Nahiri is dead rather than turned against them.
timeline.quote: I just hope she's dead,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
timeline.quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Melira discuss how the corrupted World Tree should have split the plane, and Melira says Karn is imprisoned beneath it.
timeline.quote: Norn's tree is planted below in the Seedcore, where she imprisoned Karn.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group enters Elesh Norn's altar and finds it eerily unguarded, with Kaya suspecting a trap because Ajani may be helping the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: He knows too much about us.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives at the Fair Basilica through the Planar Bridge carrying Rona's remains and demands to see Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: I must see Mother,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn summons Tezzeret and orders Rona's remains sent to Jin-Gitaxias.
timeline.quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
timeline.quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn questions Tezzeret's love for her, while Tezzeret restrains his urge to kill her.
timeline.quote: One well-placed thrust of his sharpened arm could impale her head or take it right off.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Norn that the Planeswalkers' new leader is Elspeth Tirel, wielding a blade of white light, and Norn grows fearful.
timeline.quote: The leader's name is Elspeth Tirel.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret asks for his promised darksteel body and collapses, and Norn declares a promise is a promise.
timeline.quote: A promise is a promise.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes bound in Jin-Gitaxias's laboratory, where Tamiyo was compleated.
timeline.quote: So it was happening. His reward, finally here.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias melts Tezzeret's etherium arm to bond his spine to the darksteel body.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret watched as the embodiment of his own exceptionalism melted into slag.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret's head and spine are transferred into the darksteel body and he has a vision of a clock and an island of metal.
timeline.quote: Then his head and spine were separated from his body

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret awakens in his new body but cannot planeswalk because the slab is inlaid with silver.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had fallen into the same trap.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias reveals a new Reality Chip and says he knows of Urabrask and the Mirran attacks and will let them unfold.
timeline.quote: There is no violating an agreement already broken.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret uses a telemin bond to take control of a captive scrapchief in a tank.
timeline.quote: Give me control , Phyrexian , thought Tezzeret.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret smashes the tank and the slab through the scrapchief, but Jin-Gitaxias kills it, so Tezzeret planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret planeswalked away.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Vishgraz awakens and is ordered to destroy dissenting factions with poison.
timeline.quote: Vishgraz awoke to life under the blinding white sky of the Fair Basilica
